title: The Roman Catechism
subtitle: Catechism of the Council of Trent
about: Trent asked for a catechism for parish priests (Session XXIV, 1563). It was published under Pius V in 1566 and was the Church's standard exposition of doctrine until the twentieth century. This guide follows its four parts and lists, for each chapter, the texts in this collection that teach the same doctrine. Those up to 1566 are the texts the Catechism explains; later texts are listed separately. The cross-references are made by topic for this site; the Catechism itself rarely cites texts by number.

texts.label: English translation by McHugh and Callan (1923), online text at Fordham's Internet History Sourcebooks

chapters.title: Introduction: faith and the Creed
chapters.summary: What faith is, why it is necessary, and why the Apostles summed it up in twelve articles.

chapters.title: Article 1. I believe in God, the Father almighty, Creator of heaven and earth
chapters.summary: One God in three persons; the Father; God's omnipotence; creation of all things, visible and invisible, out of nothing.

chapters.title: Article 2. And in Jesus Christ, His only Son, our Lord
chapters.summary: The name Jesus and the title Christ; the eternal generation of the Son, consubstantial with the Father.

chapters.title: Article 3. Conceived by the Holy Ghost, born of the Virgin Mary
chapters.summary: The Incarnation: one person in two natures; Mary truly Mother of God and ever a virgin.

chapters.title: Article 4. Suffered under Pontius Pilate, was crucified, died and was buried
chapters.summary: The Passion as the work of redemption, suffered in Christ's human nature, and the satisfaction He made for all.

chapters.title: Article 5. He descended into hell; the third day He rose again from the dead
chapters.summary: Christ's soul among the dead; the Resurrection in the same body.

chapters.title: Article 6. He ascended into heaven, sits at the right hand of God the Father almighty
chapters.summary: The Ascension in body and soul, and Christ's glory and power at the Father's right hand.

chapters.title: Article 7. From thence He shall come to judge the living and the dead
chapters.summary: The particular judgment at death and the general judgment at the end of the world.

chapters.title: Article 8. I believe in the Holy Ghost
chapters.summary: The divinity of the Holy Ghost and His procession from the Father and the Son; His gifts.

chapters.title: Article 9. The holy Catholic Church; the communion of saints
chapters.summary: The Church one, holy, catholic and apostolic, with Peter's successor at its head; no salvation outside it; the sharing of spiritual goods among all its members.

chapters.title: Article 10. The forgiveness of sins
chapters.summary: The power to forgive sins given to the Church, exercised in baptism and in penance.

chapters.title: Article 11. The resurrection of the body
chapters.summary: All the dead will rise in the same bodies they had in life.

chapters.title: Article 12. Life everlasting
chapters.summary: The vision of God for the blessed, the punishment of the damned, and purgatory for those still to be cleansed.

chapters.title: The sacraments in general
chapters.summary: What a sacrament is; why there are seven; matter, form and minister; the intention required; the character of baptism, confirmation and orders.

chapters.title: Baptism
chapters.summary: Its matter and form; its necessity; the minister in case of need; the baptism of infants; its effects and character.

chapters.title: Confirmation
chapters.summary: A true sacrament, with chrism as its matter; the bishop as its ordinary minister; the strength it gives.

chapters.title: The Eucharist
chapters.summary: The Real Presence; transubstantiation; communion and its dispositions; communion under one kind; the Mass as a true sacrifice.

chapters.title: Penance
chapters.summary: Penance as a virtue and a sacrament; contrition, confession and satisfaction; absolution by the priest; indulgences.

chapters.title: Extreme Unction
chapters.summary: The anointing of the sick: its matter, form and minister, who may receive it, and its effects.

chapters.title: Holy Orders
chapters.summary: The priesthood of the New Law; the degrees of orders; the hierarchy; the bishop as minister; the character.

chapters.title: Matrimony
chapters.summary: Marriage as a natural contract raised to a sacrament; its unity and indissolubility; its ends; the Church's authority over it.

chapters.title: Introduction: the law of God
chapters.summary: The commandments bind Christians, and with grace they can be kept.

chapters.title: First Commandment: I am the Lord thy God, thou shalt not have strange gods
chapters.summary: Faith, hope and charity owed to God; idolatry and superstition; the lawful honor of saints, relics and images.

chapters.title: Second Commandment: Thou shalt not take the name of the Lord thy God in vain
chapters.summary: Reverence for God's name; lawful oaths and vows; perjury and blasphemy.

chapters.title: Third Commandment: Remember that thou keep holy the Sabbath day
chapters.summary: Sunday and the feasts, kept by worship and by rest from servile work.

chapters.title: Fourth Commandment: Honor thy father and thy mother
chapters.summary: Duties of children and parents, and of subjects and those who govern.

chapters.title: Fifth Commandment: Thou shalt not kill
chapters.summary: The sanctity of life; what is and is not murder; anger and revenge.

chapters.title: Sixth Commandment: Thou shalt not commit adultery
chapters.summary: Chastity, and the sins against it in deed and desire.

chapters.title: Seventh Commandment: Thou shalt not steal
chapters.summary: Theft, usury and fraud; restitution; the right use of property.

chapters.title: Eighth Commandment: Thou shalt not bear false witness
chapters.summary: Truthfulness in court and in speech; lies, detraction and flattery.

chapters.title: Ninth and Tenth Commandments: Thou shalt not covet
chapters.summary: Interior desires against chastity and against another's goods.

chapters.title: Prayer
chapters.summary: The necessity, kinds and fruits of prayer, and the dispositions it requires.

chapters.title: Our Father who art in heaven
chapters.summary: God as Father, and the confidence with which His children approach Him.

chapters.title: First Petition: Hallowed be thy name
chapters.summary: That God's name be known, praised and honored by all.

chapters.title: Second Petition: Thy kingdom come
chapters.summary: The kingdom of grace in the Church and the kingdom of glory to come.

chapters.title: Third Petition: Thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven
chapters.summary: Obedience to God's commandments, made possible by His grace.

chapters.title: Fourth Petition: Give us this day our daily bread
chapters.summary: Bodily needs and the bread of the soul, above all the Eucharist.

chapters.title: Fifth Petition: Forgive us our trespasses
chapters.summary: All the just must ask forgiveness for daily sins; the duty to forgive others.

chapters.title: Sixth Petition: Lead us not into temptation
chapters.summary: Temptation is not sin; God's help to resist it; the gift of perseverance.

chapters.title: Seventh Petition: Deliver us from evil
chapters.summary: Deliverance from every evil, and patience in what God permits.

chapters.title: The seal of the Lord's Prayer: Amen
chapters.summary: The confidence with which the prayer is closed.
